product_metadata.title: Snoopy Sno Cone Maker
features: Brand New in box. The product ships with all relevant accessories
description: Help your kids make a cool treat with the Snoopy Sno Cone Maker. Use a hand crank to shave ice and scoop it into cups with the shovel. A padded clamp provides extra stability for this snow cone maker. Makes a perfect collectible gift for Peanuts fans young and old. For ages 4 and up.
